name: nestjs-grpc-microservices
description: Repo-level scripts. Each service under services/ is an independent npm project.

scripts.install:all: for s in services/*/; do (cd "$s" && npm ci) || exit 1; done
scripts.build:all: for s in services/*/; do (cd "$s" && npm run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck:all: for s in services/*/; do (cd "$s" && npm run typecheck) || exit 1; done
scripts.test:unit: for s in services/*/; do (cd "$s" && npm test) || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
